items.title: Why Deere (DE) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of agricultural and construction machinery company Deere (NYSE:DE) jumped 3.1% in the afternoon session after Baird analyst Mircea Dobre upgraded the stock from a Neutral rating to Outperform.

items.summary: Baird just handed two farm equipment stocks a rare double upgrade on the same morning, but the reasoning behind each call points to a very different bet on how the ag cycle turns.

items.title: How Deere Stock Can Hit $800. A Farming Recovery Is Coming.

A recovery is coming in 2027 that will benefit farmers, as well as shares of Deere AGCO CNH Industrial, and CNH dealer Titan Machinery  Baird analyst Mig Dobre upgraded all four stocks to Buy from Hold on Monday.
